questions.prompt: True or false: “Adding heat to something increases its temperature.”

hints.nudge: Read the statement slowly. Does it match what the article says, or has one word been swapped for another?
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Heat article.

questions.proof: Adding heat to something increases its temperature.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “A _____ that is easier to move will need less heat for the same change in temperature.”

hints.nudge: The missing word names one thing, not an action. The words on each side of the gap show what kind of thing fits.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Properties of Heat” part of the Heat article.

questions.proof: A particle that is easier to move will need less heat for the same change in temperature.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Heat is usually measured with a _____.”
